observed_content: Exact law-family inference on four independent one-step functions (affine, quadratic, piecewise-linear with hinge at zero, rational P1/Q2) and one second-order affine recurrence. Fitting uses overdetermined rational elimination, uniqueness, minimum parameter count and held-out predictions; 11 training x values and 14 held-out per one-step law, 10 training history pairs and 6 held-out recurrence pairs.
negative_controls: Two observations x=0,1 for quadratic x²−x+2 coincide with constant 2; divergence at x=2; quadratic fit rejected as underidentified.
Same current=1 but different prior state gives different next value for second-order recurrence.

retrieval_log.result: 75 exact assertions passed; 56 scalar heldouts and 6 recurrence heldouts correct

interpretation: Governing law recovered within a predeclared set of family types; the family library, hinge location and memory order are assumptions. Not universal law discovery.
limitations: Synthetic systems selected by assistant, not externally blind
Candidate families and hinge location specified in advance
Does not prove ROOT0 mathematical priority or derivation of RH/Navier-Stokes work
